name: SendRaven
description: Email infrastructure for AI agents: send, receive, and hold conversations over email. Sending requires a verified domain. Replies are threaded automatically and returned with quoted history removed. Each operation names the scope its key needs in x-required-scope. API key management (/v1/api-keys) is deliberately not described here. Every error is { error: { type, message } }, and a type has the same meaning and status on every route (see the Error schema). A path or method this API does not serve answers 404 not_found with the message "No such API route", which is different wording from a missing resource.
